SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM kitchen_order GROUP BY status

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day_key, TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD') AS day_label, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM kitchen_order WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY day_key, day_label ORDER BY day_key

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day_key, TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'MM-DD') AS day_label, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cnt FROM kitchen_order WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY day_key, day_label ORDER BY day_key

SELECT oi.dish_name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS cnt FROM kitchen_order_item oi INNER JOIN kitchen_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY oi.dish_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
